name: Florence
summary: Florence is the cradle of the Renaissance, with a density of artistic heritage that is difficult to match and a human scale that allows you to explore it on foot in a few minutes. It combines intense cultural life with a lower cost of living than Rome or Milan and an excellent rail connection with the rest of Europe. Its compact size and university character make it attractive for stays of several months.
